name: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B

architecture.anatomy: Early-fusion vision encoder on a causal LM MoE; HF safetensors counts 403.4B params including the encoder

summary: Qwen3.5 flagship MoE with unified vision-language foundation: 397B total, 17B active, 256K native context. Hosted counterpart is Qwen3.5-Plus.

practical_baseline.rationale: The only reported stable 4-bit-or-better consumer-hardware lane; it depends on heavy SSD expert streaming and is labelled accordingly.
